name: weeklygrant
description: Estimate the API-equivalent value of a weekly Codex grant from local session logs.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/bin/cli.ts src/bin/estimate-worker.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --minify --outdir=dist --outbase=src --entry-names=[dir]/[name] --chunk-names=bin/chunk-[hash] && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/bin/cli.js', 0o755)"
scripts.prepack: npm test && npm run check && npm run build

author: aneeshpatne
